"""Request handlers."""

from app.services import users


def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    raw = params.get("id")
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
    if user is None:
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
    return 200, user

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_DIGITS = "0123456789"
+_WHITESPACE = " \t\n\r\f\v"
+_OPERATORS = "+-*/()"
+
+
+class _ParseError(Exception):
+    """Raised when an expression is not valid."""
+
+
+def _tokenize(expr: str) -> list[tuple[str, object]]:
+    tokens: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
+    i = 0
+    n = len(expr)
+    while i < n:
+        ch = expr[i]
+        if ch in _WHITESPACE:
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if ch in _DIGITS:
+            j = i
+            while j < n and expr[j] in _DIGITS:
+                j += 1
+            tokens.append(("num", int(expr[i:j])))
+            i = j
+            continue
+        if ch in _OPERATORS:
+            tokens.append((ch, None))
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        raise _ParseError
+    return tokens
+
+
+class _Parser:
+    """Recursive-descent parser producing a small expression tree."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tokens: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> None:
+        self.tokens = tokens
+        self.pos = 0
+
+    def _peek(self) -> str | None:
+        if self.pos < len(self.tokens):
+            return self.tokens[self.pos][0]
+        return None
+
+    def _advance(self) -> tuple[str, object]:
+        token = self.tokens[self.pos]
+        self.pos += 1
+        return token
+
+    def parse(self) -> tuple:
+        node = self._expr()
+        if self.pos != len(self.tokens):
+            raise _ParseError
+        return node
+
+    def _expr(self) -> tuple:
+        node = self._term()
+        while self._peek() in ("+", "-"):
+            op = self._advance()[0]
+            node = ("bin", op, node, self._term())
+        return node
+
+    def _term(self) -> tuple:
+        node = self._unary()
+        while self._peek() in ("*", "/"):
+            op = self._advance()[0]
+            node = ("bin", op, node, self._unary())
+        return node
+
+    def _unary(self) -> tuple:
+        if self._peek() == "-":
+            self._advance()
+            return ("neg", self._unary())
+        return self._primary()
+
+    def _primary(self) -> tuple:
+        token = self._peek()
+        if token == "num":
+            return ("num", self._advance()[1])
+        if token == "(":
+            self._advance()
+            node = self._expr()
+            if self._peek() != ")":
+                raise _ParseError
+            self._advance()
+            return node
+        raise _ParseError
+
+
+def _evaluate(node: tuple):
+    kind = node[0]
+    if kind == "num":
+        return node[1]
+    if kind == "neg":
+        return -_evaluate(node[1])
+    _, op, left, right = node
+    a = _evaluate(left)
+    b = _evaluate(right)
+    if op == "+":
+        return a + b
+    if op == "-":
+        return a - b
+    if op == "*":
+        return a * b
+    if b == 0:
+        raise ZeroDivisionError
+    return a / b
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_calc(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    expr = params.get("expr")
+    if not isinstance(expr, str) or len(expr) > 100:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid expression"}
+    try:
+        node = _Parser(_tokenize(expr)).parse()
+        result = _evaluate(node)
+    except _ParseError:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid expression"}
+    except ZeroDivisionError:
+        return 400, {"error": "division by zero"}
+    if isinstance(result, float) and result.is_integer():
+        result = int(result)
+    return 200, {"result": result}

from app.api.handlers import handle_calc
cases = [
    ("1+2", (200, {"result": 3})),
    ("2*3+4", (200, {"result": 10})),
    ("2+3*4", (200, {"result": 14})),
    ("10/2", (200, {"result": 5})),
    ("1/2", (200, {"result": 0.5})),
    ("(1+2)*3", (200, {"result": 9})),
    ("-5+3", (200, {"result": -2})),
    ("2--3", (200, {"result": 5})),
    ("2*-3", (200, {"result": -6})),
    ("6/2/3", (200, {"result": 1})),
    ("  7  ", (200, {"result": 7})),
    ("1/0", (400, {"error": "division by zero"})),
    ("1/(2-2)", (400, {"error": "division by zero"})),
    ("0/0", (400, {"error": "division by zero"})),
    ("1/0+", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("abc", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("1+", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("()", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("1 2", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("+5", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("(1+2", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("1)", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("1.5", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("1e3", (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ("9"*101, (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    (None, (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    (123, (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
    ({"expr": "1+"+" "*99}, (400, {"error": "invalid expression"})),
]
bad = 0
for expr, want in cases:
    got = handle_calc({"expr": expr})
    ok = got == want
    if not ok:
        bad += 1
        print("FAIL", repr(expr), "got", got, "want", want)
print("checked", len(cases), "failures", bad)

# exactly 100 chars valid
long_expr = "1+1" * 25  # 100 chars
print("100-char:", handle_calc({"expr": long_expr}))
# 101 chars valid-ish -> invalid
print("101-char:", handle_calc({"expr": long_expr + "1"}))
EOF
